messages:
Josh: Quick heads-up — planning a blue->green traffic shift for router R1 at 03:00 UTC. We’ll do 10% steps every 5m. Canary target = green:v2. Health gates: 2xx rate, p95 latency, error-rate <1%.
Amanda: Ack. Adding release notes now. Do we want to pin session-affinity change?
Josh: Yes — session cookie name will change (sid_v2). I’ll push route weight + pin option during the shift.
DeployBot: @channel routeshift:start id=rs-20240427-9 payload={"from":"blue:v1","to":"green:v2","steps":[{"pct":10,"wait":"5m"},{"pct":20,"wait":"5m"},{"pct":40,"wait":"5m"}]} — started by Josh at 1719456789
Priya: Watching metrics. If p95 > 350ms or 2xx < 98% we hold. Ping me if you see >0.5% errors. :rotating_light:
Marco: FYI seeing warmup jitter in eu-west edge (p95 +120ms baseline). Might hit step 2.
DeployBot: step 1 complete — green at 10%. metrics: 2xx=99.3%, p95=210ms (global).
Priya: Step 2 probing — eu-west p95 jumped to 340ms and 503s spiked to 0.8% from edge-proxy-3. Recommend pause and regional hold.
Amanda: Can we pin EU traffic to blue until investigated? Use regional override.
Josh: Agreed. Pausing global shift. @DeployBot run region-hold id=rs-20240427-9 region=eu-west override={"pct":0,"to":"blue:v1"} — manual hold requested.
DeployBot: region-hold applied for eu-west. Global shift paused at overall 20%. Note: "routeshift:paused by Josh — region override eu-west"
Oncall-Ops: I’ll spin a debug trace on edge-proxy-3 and pull recent logs. Tagging Marco + Priya for help.
Marco: Trace started — snippet:
```
curl -H "Host: router.redwood" http://edge-proxy-3/health
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-edge-err: upstream-timeout
```
Priya: Looks like upstream timeouts to the new model-serving pool in eu-west-dc2. I’m initiating rollback of the affected pool instances.
DeployBot: rollback:pool eu-west-dc2 instances=[pool-34,pool-35] requested by Priya. ETA ~3m.
DeployBot: rollback:pool completed for [pool-34,pool-35]. Pools drained and reverted to previous kernel. Global shift remains paused pending manual resume.
Josh: Thanks. Keep eu-west pinned to blue. Once metrics hold (2xx >99% and p95 <300ms for 10m) we can resume. I’ll target resume at 03:30 UTC if stable. :eyes:
Amanda: Noted for release notes: session-cookie rename, regional hold EU, rollback of eu-west pool. Owners: Josh / Marco / Priya. I’ll add a short changelog and link to the incident doc.
Oncall-Ops: Adding timeline and actions to incident tracker now.
DeployBot: admin:resume requires manual approval — auto-resume disabled.
Josh: OK. Leaving this thread open for final resume call. Ping here when good. :thumbsup:
